description: The bar chart illustrates the performance ratio (in percentage) of three large language models — Llama3 (blue), Qwen2 (red), and ChatGPT (yellow) — across three distinct knowledge domains: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The vertical axis represents the “Ratio (%)” ranging from 50% to 90%, with tick marks at 10% intervals. The horizontal axis categorizes the domains, with each domain displaying three adjacent bars corresponding to the three models. In the “Movies” category, Llama3 and Qwen2 both achieve approximately 90%, while ChatGPT scores around 73%. In “Songs,” Qwen2 again leads at ~90%, followed by Llama3 at ~84% and ChatGPT at ~62%. In “Basketball,” Llama3 scores ~67%, Qwen2 drops to ~57%, and ChatGPT reaches ~61%. The chart visually suggests that Qwen2 performs best in popular domains (Movies, Songs), while Llama3 maintains relatively strong performance across all categories, and ChatGPT shows more variability, particularly underperforming in Songs. The models are consistently color-coded in the legend, and the bars are grouped by domain rather than sorted by value, allowing direct comparison within each knowledge area. No error bars or statistical annotations are present, and the chart focuses purely on comparative performance ratios without indicating sample size or confidence intervals.
